items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: With his small group, his quintet. How long did you stay with him?

ctx.x: With his small group, his quintet. How long did you stay with him?
Up until just here a couple of years ago, just left him, which was, what is this '80? About '77.

items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: But then, after I come out of the Embers and I've got Cozy too, I can't tell him to stay on brushes all night.

ctx.x: Well, now I use that buzz mute and I use the plunger, and I don't use the bucket anymore because I'm

playing open again. See, I could do that before with what I was doing in the Embers, because they said no open horns. So I made the drummer stay on brushes. That's so he won't overpower me and blow me out. But then, after I come out of the Embers and I've got Cozy too, I can't tell him to stay on brushes all night. He ain't used to playing with brushes. So he's playing with sticks, so it give me a chance to open up, see. So now I open up. I'll just play a little thing, maybe I'll start off one number, maybe I'll…
Yeah, but you know that -- there are still people who would like that.
